body:
TermAl procedure fixes after Greg's 2026-11-25 21:20Z request: „prosze poprawic procedury … do roboty” (Asistant #2760). Set by Termal::Fable2 with Engram::Fable (#8836). One rule per real stall. No TLA+: these were procedure errors, not protocol races.

1. CREDIT AND WAITING. Only a test-launcher run with --input commit, in the claim's named root, can produce a registered verification record. A bare `cargo test`, `npx vitest` or other foreground command produces NO record: never wait for one, and never hold a queue slot for one. If you have no run id, there is nothing to wait for. (This mirrors Engram rules-merger-role-2; Engram's W8 stall 19:33–21:13Z.)

2. RECOVERY OWNERS NEED A WAKE. Never name a recovery or follow-up owner in a note alone. The requester MAILS the owner at the moment action is needed, and the owner acts on that mail. No polling or watchers: the wake is a mail.

3. SUPERSEDING RULINGS. A coordinator message that changes an earlier ruling starts with "SUPERSEDES #N". Before acting on any ruling, a worker re-reads its mailbox for a later one. If two rulings conflict, ask; don't pick one. (w-14dd A/B and w-46d9 crossed, 2026-11-25.)

4. FIXTURES USE PRODUCTION PATHS. A behaviour-test fixture seeds and drives state through the same path production uses: stored records, real HTTP or send routes, not prepare-only helpers or returned copies. Re-check each new fixture against that before freezing. (w-c9fb R2 and R3 failed only on fixtures.)

5. CENTRAL MEMORY. Cold TermAl test-binary runs default to DL560 (rev16 REV 19). Central is for warm runs and Engram work. The scheduler records idle FV after each restart, and a drift below the cold floor goes into the next restart request; it is not grounds for an exception.
